reason: A web-session visualization plugin that detects Mermaid code fences in chat messages and renders them as themed SVG diagrams with lazy, viewport-aware loading and fullscreen inspection.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话消息中将 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为支持主题切换和放大查看的 SVG 图表。
summaries.en: Renders Mermaid code fences in DSH Web messages as themed SVG diagrams with lazy loading and fullscreen inspection.

capabilities: Renders Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams in web chat messages
Lazily loads Mermaid in the browser
Adds viewport-aware asynchronous rendering and fullscreen diagram viewing
Modifies rendered message DOM and provides error-copy and AI-repair interaction
